name: Saint Margaret Mary Alacoque
history: A Visitation nun at Paray-le-Monial to whom Christ revealed His Sacred Heart in a series of visions between 1673 and 1675. Doubted by her community, she persevered, and the devotion to the Sacred Heart spread through the whole Church, with its First Fridays and the feast of the Sacred Heart.
meditation: Behold this Heart which has so loved men. Make an act of reparation today for indifference to that love.
